E0191 UNCHANGED L13 |     str,
E0192 UNCHANGED L14 |     bytes,
E0193 UNCHANGED L15 |     list[t.Any],
E0194 UNCHANGED L16 |     # Only dict is actually accepted, but Mapping allows for TypedDict.
E0195 UNCHANGED L17 |     t.Mapping[str, t.Any],

E0197 UNCHANGED L19 |     t.Iterator[bytes],
